body:
## [3.103.2] - 2026-11-02

### Bug Fixes

- accept six through ten digits when enabled (AION-693)
- allow numeric lookup from four digits (AION-693)
- include company policy view cleanup in QA backend
- apply company legacy policies to gift card payments
- support configured six-digit legacy vouchers (AION-693)

### Other Changes

- Fixed prepay to honor its separate eligibility rules. Hidden Cash methods with allowPrepayFuel=true can now capture payment; ordinary checkout filtering remains unchanged.
- add settings Tax Invoice / Delivery Note
- Pay Later / Customer Account is hidden when the order total is below zero, including split payments and keyboard selection.
- update live receipt fake for receipt-specific loading
- Fixed. Non-invoice Pay Later receipts now show Delivery Note in preview and printing.
